channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Corey Maggette | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Corey Maggette from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Glen Davis on Corey Maggette, Gilbert Arenas, Matt Barnes, Tony Allen
item.description:
“Matt Barnes, Stephen Jack; all those people were investigated. Gilbert Arenas, Corey Maggette, Cutino Mobley; thousands of NBA players were investigated. They just let some of them go to jail. Some of them, the fed got, like, Tony Allen. He didn't go to jail. Whatever he did to get free.”

Glen Davis on Corey Maggette, Gilbert Arenas, Matt Barnes, Tony Allen, Sep 5, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand
item.description:
Cuttino Mobley:

“And people don’t understand, if you look at my numbers for that season with the Clippers, I could have been an All-Star that year. But again, I don’t care. I don’t care because Elton Brand was an All-Star. Corey Maggette averaged 20. We made the playoffs. We beat the Denver Nuggets in five. It was the first time the Clippers had ever been out of the first round. That was my All-Star.”

Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand, Oct 5, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand, Shaun Livingston, Sam Cassell
item.description:
Cuttino Mobley:

“There were times, man, where I'd score like 15 first quarter, 12 first quarter, and then I’d feel that—and I have to give the ball up. You know what I’m saying? Like, I always wanted to be part of the group, never lead the group—until I started getting older. Then I was fine with leading, but letting everybody else shine. That was my role with the Clippers—with Elton Brand, Corey Maggette, Shaun Livingston, and Sam Cassell.”

Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand, Shaun Livingston, Sam Cassell, Oct 5, 2025. Source: YouTube.
